aspect: A grief with no memory attached
description: Strong feeling about an event they cannot remember, which is socially illegitimate - they know they have no right to it, and they have it anyway.
The grandchild who gets told the story the children were never told, usually once, usually late, usually with an instruction not to upset anyone.
energy_note: Handed the whole thing at twenty-three, alone.

aspect: Obligation to succeed on behalf of the dead
description: The achievement is framed as vindication of people who did not survive. That is a heavy engine and it does not have an off switch.

aspect: The identity is inherited whether or not it is wanted
description: Some descendants organise their lives around it; others refuse it entirely. Both are responses to something they did not choose, and the refusal costs as much effort as the embrace.
energy_note: Opting out is also a full-time position.

description: She is 26, born in Hamburg, and does not speak the language. A man at a party hears her surname and asks about a war that ended before her mother was born. She does not know the answer and feels, precisely, like a fraud.
energy_note: Interrogated about a war you have no memory of.
